newsitem.title: USA: Wyser-Pratte disappointed by Rexene delay.
newsitem.headline: Wyser-Pratte disappointed by Rexene delay.

text.p: Investors Guy Wyser-Pratte and Fred Kambeitz said they are disappointed by Rexene Corp's decision to delay the company's annual meeting.
Wyser-Pratte and Kambeitz said in a joint statement that Rexene officials told investors and analysts in a conference call that the meeting could be delayed to as late as "June or July."
A spokesman for Rexene said the company has not yet determined a meeting date, but it is likely to be held during its traditional months of April or May.
"This is an attempt by Wyser-Pratte to distort the company's statements for their own end," the Rexene spokesman said.

Eric Longmire, senior managing director at Wyser-Pratte & Co Inc, said Rexene shareholders' interests would not be best served by delaying the meeting because potential buyers of the company may find other acquisitions. Huntsman Corp has indicated an interest in buying Rexene.

Wyser-Pratte & Co and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg own a combined 10.1 percent stake interest in Rexene and are calling for a special meeting to change Rexene's by-laws and nominate their own slate of directors, Longmire said.
Their slate would set up a special committee to put the company up for public auction, Longmire said.
Longmire said the nominees are proposing to change Rexene's by-laws so shareholders would be able to overrule the board of directors, if the board rejects an attractive merger offer.
